descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S22 Real phone, both modes: a dictated point, and a phone clock two days behind or 13 h ahead

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. … (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U2 Three points added via '+ Add Point', one per line, show as three separate cards, not one merged card, in both Hospital and Nursing Home (Nursing Home per PR #57). (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U8 The expiry clock uses server time, not device time: a phone with a wrong date, no clock set, or another time zone shows the same points as any other device. (UAT 3.8; TFA-94699 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Points expire 12 h after they were written; a point checked 13 h after it was written is gone (Hospital 3.6: Important Points 12 h; TC-12 step 6 repeats it in Nursing Home). … (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.6; TFA-92590 AC 6; TFA-94699 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Local stack only: never dev (), prod, TestFlight or a store build, and never the store-review account. Android: the debug APK bundled for the local stack as scripts/android-lane.ts installs it, with adb reverse tcp:4510 and tcp:4511. iOS: only a local Xcode debug build pointed at the local stack; …

When Dictation: Hospital: Add Point > Dictate point, say one point, Stop, Save Point. Nursing Home: editor bottom box > Dictate, say one point. Then Save Note in each. Clock: on the wrong-clock phone add a point, Save Note, open and close the editor; open the app on both devices; …

Then The dictated point is the transcription as heard (no cleanup), one card, unchanged after Save Note; the keyboard does not hide the box. Both devices show the wrong-clock phone's point right after it is written; it expires 12 h after it was written by server time on both

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester compares the stored card with what was said; the speech-to-text engine is recorded (3.9). Clock half: UAT 3.8; main writes ptsEditedAt with the device's Date.now(), so a phone two days behind makes the point look 48 h old and the server lifecycle deletes it on the next open: expected Fail. The browser half of the clock check is S23.

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
